metas.name: Helluva Boss
metas.description: This adult animated comedy follows the misadventures, hijinks, and relationships of the Immediate Murder Professionals (or I.M.P. for short)-- a band of demon assassins from Hell who kill people on Earth for a living.

metas.name: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
Free Leonard Peltier
metas.description: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.

metas.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
metas.description: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

metas.name: TYSON
metas.description: Explore the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

metas.name: The Trap
metas.description: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

metas.name: Game Day Murders
metas.description: Veteran sportscaster Lindsay Czarniak explores the deadly intersection of sports and crime through six murder investigations involving athletes. Each episode blends a gripping whodunit with the culture surrounding the game.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: Um Vision renovado tem-se escondido daqueles que procuram transformá-lo numa arma. Enquanto mantém um perfil discreto, consulta as personalidades de IA incorporadas na sua programação, incluindo o infame Ultron, para descobrir o seu verdadeiro propósito.  Esta vida tranquila de autorreflexão termina quando uma recompensa pela sua captura o obriga a fugir ao lado de Thomas Shepard, um rapaz misterioso que poderá ser a reencarnação do filho de Vision.

metas.name: Love Is Blind
metas.description: Nick e Vanessa Lachey apresentam uma experiência social em que solteiros e solteiras encontram o amor e ficam noivos sem se conhecerem cara a cara.

metas.name: Hunting Gary Glitter
metas.description: Survivors, journalists and legal experts recount how pop star Gary Glitter used his money, fame and influence to carry out decades of child sexual abuse.

metas.name: Car S.O.S.
metas.description: Conheça o entusiasta de automóveis e apresentador de TV Tim Shaw e o mestre mecânico Fuzz Townshend enquanto unem forças para resgatar veículos clássicos enferrujados das suas garagens abandonadas.

metas.name: The Diplomat
metas.description: Durante uma crise internacional, uma diplomata dos EUA concilia o seu trabalho como embaixadora no Reino Unido com o seu tenso casamento com um político conceituado.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Struggling actress Trina Vega returns to her former high school, Hollywood Arts, as an unqualified substitute teacher, quickly finding herself both clashing with and unexpectedly inspiring a new generation of ambitious and talented students as they learn to find their true path at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: Money Trap
metas.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

metas.name: Marília Mendonça: All the Feels
metas.description: How did an ordinary girl from the heart of Brazil become a phenomenon? Through previously unreleased footage, audio recordings and interviews, the series traces Marília Mendonça's meteoric rise from singing at a gas station to becoming one of Brazil's biggest artists.

metas.name: The Real Rooneys
metas.description: A candid glimpse into the Rooneys' world as soccer legend Wayne juggles dad duties and former England captain's wife Coleen balances motherhood with business ambitions.

metas.name: Hometown Giants
metas.description: Step inside the Vancouver Giants major junior hockey team, where celebrity owners Michael Bublé and Drew Scott set out to revive a franchise that hasn't won a championship since 2007. For the players, they're teenagers living away from home, finishing high school, and chasing NHL dreams they've built their lives around, even though only a few will ever make it.

metas.name: 100 Days of Deception
metas.description:
100 Days of Deception (100일의 거짓말) is an upcoming 2026 South Korean period espionage television series directed by Yoo In-shik and written by Ryu Bo-ri. Scheduled to premiere on tvN on October 10, 2026, and broadcast internationally via Netflix, the drama is set in 1932 Gyeongseong under Japanese colonial rule.

The narrative follows a skilled pickpocket who assumes a fake identity to infiltrate the Japanese Government-General of Joseon as an undercover spy for the independence movement. Over the course of a 100-day mission, her operation collides with an elite interpreter who is the son of the Inspector General. The ensemble cast features Kim You-jung and Park Jin-young.

metas.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
metas.description: Numa distopia mergulhada em corrupção e paixão pelos implantes corporais, um miúdo talentoso, mas imprudente, esforça-se para se tornar um mercenário fora da lei.

metas.name: Where's Wanda?
metas.description: Após o desaparecimento da filha dos Klatts, eles decidem resolver o problema sozinhos e traçam um plano louco: espiar a vizinhança. À medida que se aventuram na pequena espionagem, segredos chocantes vêm à tona, um a um.

metas.name: The Mothers of Penguins
metas.description: Quando o seu filho de sete anos muda de escola, uma lutadora de MMA apercebe-se de que a sua maior luta não vai ser travada no octógono, mas sim na parentalidade.

metas.name: The Terminal List
metas.description: O Tenente-Comandante James Reece decide vingar-se e investigar as forças misteriosas por detrás do assassinato do seu pelotão inteiro. Livre da estrutura do comando militar, Reece põe em prática o que aprendeu em quase duas décadas de serviço militar para ir atrás dos responsáveis.

metas.name: Six Kings Slam
metas.description: Six Kings. One crown. The world's top-ranked men's players take the court in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for a star-studded, live tennis showcase.

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
metas.description: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

metas.name: Nobody Wants This
metas.description: Uma agnóstica com um podcast sobre sexo e um rabino recém-solteiro apaixonam-se. Mas pode esta relação sobreviver a estilos de vida opostos e a famílias abelhudas?

metas.name: Fading Grandeur
metas.description: Don Leandro, a marquis facing a dire financial situation, decides to part with the decaying family mansion he owns in Madrid. Sofía Carrington, a multimillionaire businesswoman, shows interest in acquiring the property. What initially appears to be a real estate transaction soon becomes complicated, as the relationship between the two goes beyond mere financial negotiation.

metas.name: Lupin
metas.description: Inspirado pelas aventuras de Arsène Lupin, o ladrão de casaca Assane Diop está decidido a vingar o pai por uma injustiça acometida por uma família abastada.
